title: Any mods with swappable modules?
author: Zsar
contentHtml:
I would like to actually see Gemini containers and possibly containers on Buffalo and Atlas as well, which can be swapped and may house specialisations, which allow the ship to take on a different role at similar ease as we can currently swap hullmods.

(A real-world example would be the Airbus GVTC - there are also models housing kitchens, plain storage space, armouries, etc.)

Does any mod have the code to add and remove whole modules from a ship, which I could steal inspire myself from?
